queries.latency_note: Closed loop: one outstanding request per client, cycling through shapes with staggered starting shapes. Latency includes the entire body (CSV drained and discarded). Requests started before duration finish afterwards; latency includes all outcomes, successful_latency only complete 200 responses. No retries. Empty shapes invalidate the run.
queries.mix_note: Name plus source is replaced by name plus a seeded person: the explorer supports person_id, not source. The M8/M4 seed writes source=api on every event. category is low cardinality (six values); amount is high cardinality (0..200 at two decimal places).

explorer\\timeout-default\\clients-1\\co.measurement: ingest and explorer launched together for the same duration; explorer drains in-flight requests afterwards; ingest p99 is from schedule; EXPLAIN and retained counts run outside this window

explorer\\timeout-default\\clients-1\\in.latency_note: One sample per request at its final outcome of any status (202, 4xx, 5xx, timeout or transport error, 429 retries exhausted). latency_from_schedule runs from the request's scheduled due time to its final response, retry waits and dispatch lag included: judge API latency targets on it. dispatch_lag is the final send minus the scheduled time and service_latency the final attempt's send to response, so latency_from_schedule is about dispatch_lag plus service_latency.
